text:
Maya Chen: hey team :wave: quick sync on LumenArc preview - they're ready for seats but we've got a few blockers on enablement and risk for renewal
Samir Patel: can you paste the list of features they're trialing and which reps are assigned?
Maya Chen: features = streaming embeddings, rerank endpoint, and automated cache. Rep = Taylor (customer sponsor). Renewal on their side in ~4 months, low usage flagged last quarter :eyes:
Priya Nair: low usage + security review pending = renewal risk. We should prioritize SSO + audit logs to unblock engineering stake-holders.
Jorge Alvarez: engineering team asked for sample traffic pattern and a short runbook. I'll prepare a 1-pager.
Maya Chen: thanks Jorge. Action items: (1) Samir confirm seat list, (2) Jorge 1-pager, (3) Priya coordinate SSO call with Taylor. Aim to close major blockers in 10 business days.
Samir Patel: seat list: Taylor + 3 data scientists + 1 infra = 5 seats. I'll invite them to the enablement session.
Taylor (LumenArc): thanks! morning works best for our team. SSO is a blocker for our security team; audit logs are also required for compliance.
onboard-bot: preview-seat-assigned: 5 seats provisioned for lumenarc-org (seat IDs: s-22..s-26)
Priya Nair: Taylor — can you share the IdP metadata? If you DM it we can get SAML set up this week. Also will send calendar options for enablement.
Taylor (LumenArc): sending DM now.
Jorge Alvarez: draft 1-pager uploaded here: https://redwood.internal/summaries/lumenarc-trial-patterns (contains expected qps, burst scenarios, and a rollback plan)
Maya Chen: perfect. Samir, block 45 mins with Taylor & their DS lead. We'll cover runbook + quick eval checklist.
Samir Patel: done — invite sent for Tuesday 10am PT. Added agenda: 1) SSO checklist 2) demo of rerank latency 3) feedback capture cadence.
Priya Nair: I'll own audit-log delivery and provide ETA by EOD Friday.
Taylor (LumenArc): appreciate it. also curious about token usage reporting for billing—can we get a weekly export?
Maya Chen: yep — export enabled for their org. I will ping product-ops for a scheduled CSV drop.
Jorge Alvarez: one more note: enablement should include a short failover walkthrough (what to do if model falls back to smaller variant). Helps with their reliability concerns.
Maya Chen: good call. We'll include a short scripted test they can run post-session.
Samir Patel: next check-in after the Tues call. tagging follow-ups: @Priya Nair, @Jorge Alvarez, @Maya Chen. :thumbsup:
Taylor (LumenArc): thanks everyone — excited to get started!
Maya Chen: closing notes: track as "high-touch preview" in RevOps to surface renewal cadence. I'll add to CS workspace.
Priya Nair: noted. adding renewal-risk flag and setting biweekly health pulses.
Maya Chen: thanks all — thread closed until post-enablement check-in.
